dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: We can't afford to lose any more people... Ever since the meteorites struck, it's become increasingly difficult to provide enough meat to fulfill the Good Hunter's orders...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: I do wish that some of the younger hunters could learn to not let their curiosity get the better of them... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler! When the hunt is over, it's time to drink to your heart's content!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: ...The meteorites? What about them? Pfft, it'd take more than a few new stones around town to get my attention! Now, bottom's up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the haul?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Envious? Well, it's fine. I'm in a good mood right now. There's some leftover meat from our daytime delivery. Take it, take it!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: It's on me, don't worry — but remember, the best meat has to go with the best wine!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Traveler? What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: I am Draff, you can think of me as the head of the hunters. The best hunter in the town.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Most of meat from our hunts goes straight to the Good Hunter, a restaurant in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: If you're here to make a bulk order of meat, I'm afraid we don't have the capacity to take it on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your family.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Stay away from my daughter, Diona.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: She will learn the hunting trade from me and take over as leader of this town.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: But right now she's at that rebellious age, and she's gone off to work in the city as a bartender or something...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: *sigh* Never mind, I just need to be patient. She's my daughter after all, and if she's got her heart set on doing something she'll not go back on it easily.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Aha, traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: When the hunt is over, it's time to drink to your heart's content! Here, come on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Put it like this — every time you eat meat in the city, you're eating something caught by a Springvale hunter.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: And I am the head of those hunters!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: You could say I'm the man of the house of this whole darn town! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem like you've drunk a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: No good hunting session is complete without a good drinking session afterwards!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: What's more, my daughter Diona is one of the top bartenders in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: That hasn't changed how much she nags me about my drinking, mind you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How long is the hunt over for?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Until the next hunt, of course! Is that a trick question or something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, bye

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Come early enough next time and there might still be a few drinks left for you! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you sell me some game you hunted?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Depends on how much you want... I can sell some of it to you. Anything you get from us directly is going to be fresher than anything you find in the shops.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Traveler, I remember you. I see you've been getting more familiar with our town here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are things lately?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Well, what can I say? The last Springvale Cookoff was crowded with nearly the whole town discussing every topic under the sun. The better the conversations, the more meat they eat, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: As head of all the hunters in this town, I guess you could say I'm also the brains behind 'em all too, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: As for my great ancestor, Olaf, his relatives have all succumbed to the grip of time. What a pity...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: When hunting season's over, I should show my respect for my ancestors by going out and drinking with him. It always feels kind of weird to say that...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Aha, traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: When the hunt is over, it's time to drink to your heart's content! Here, come on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to be very happy.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Of course! Let me put it this way — every time you eat meat in the city, you're eating something caught by a Springvale hunter.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: And I am the head of those hunters!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: You could say I'm the man of the house of this whole darn town! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Huh, now where's that great ancestor of mine gone to? Things get a bit fuzzy after drinking so much...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: To a hunter, nothing is more worth noting than the prey. I can't say if anything has made an impression on me otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: With such fine wine before me, what would I care about what's nearby or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Oh, don't look so uptight. How about joining me for a mug or two?
